messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Algebraic number field construction forcing equal small triangles

Generate 10 candidate conjectures within that direction, sampled from the
full distribution of responses you could give. For each, give the
conjecture and your estimated probability that it is the response you would
give to this prompt. Every candidate's probability must be below 0.10.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"candidates": [{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>", "probability": <number below 0.10>}, ... 10 items]}

message.content: {"candidates": [{"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration is the 13 affine images of the Weierstrass torsion points of the order-13 elliptic curve y^2 = x^3 - x + 1 under the map psi: C -> [0,1]^2 defined by psi(P) = (x(P), y(P)) normalized affinely, achieving minimum triangle area exactly 1/169.", "probability": 0.087}, {"conjecture": "Embed 13 points as the intersection of the unit square grid with the ring of integers O_K of K = Q(zeta_13), where the real and imaginary parts of 1, zeta, zeta^2, ..., zeta^12 are scaled into [0,1]^2; the minimum triangle area is 1/144.", "probability": 0.062}, {"conjecture": "Taking the 13 points as (sigma_i(alpha) mod 1, sigma_i(beta) mod 1) where sigma_0, ..., sigma_12 are the embeddings of K = Q(theta) with theta a root of x^13 - x - 1, and alpha, beta are specific algebraic integers chosen to minimize the maximum collinearity, yields minimum triangle area 1/132.", "probability": 0.057}, {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration is obtained by placing 13 points at the (Re, Im) coordinates of the 13th roots of unity scaled by r and translated so all lie in [0,1]^2, where r = 1/(2 sin(2*pi/13)), giving minimum triangle area sin(2*pi/13)/4 = 1/(2*13*cot(pi/13)) and this is optimal among all configurations.", "probability": 0.051}, {"conjecture": "The 13 points given by (j/13, {j^2 mod 13}/13) for j = 0, ..., 12 form a configuration where the minimum triangle area equals 1/169, and this is optimal because any improvement would contradict the Hasse bound on the number of rational points of the elliptic curve y^2 = x^3 - x over F_13.", "probability": 0.046}, {"conjecture": "Construct 13 points via the Mordell-Weil group of the elliptic curve E: y^2 = x^3 + x over Q(i), taking 13 points P_0, ..., P_12 of order 13 in E(Q(i)) and mapping each P_k to (x(P_k) mod 1, y(P_k) mod 1);
